summary_en: How to apply to a German programme from India: whether your certificate admits you directly or needs a Studienkolleg, TestDaF/DSH language proof and when it is waived, the uni-assist and Hochschulstart routes and their fees, and the 11,904 euro proof of financing.
steps_json: [{"title": "Check whether your school certificate qualifies you directly", "body": "Recognition depends on your country of origin and falls into four categories: general admission, subject-restricted admission, admission only after one to two years of prior university study at home, or no recognition. If your certificate is judged insufficient you must complete a Studienkolleg foundation course before enrolling. The anabin and ZAB databases record how a given qualification is treated.", "links": ["https://www.study-in-germany.com/en/plan-your-studies/requirements/entrance-qualification/", "https://anabin.kmk.org/no_cache/filter/schulabschluesse-mit-hochschulzugang.html", "https://zab.kmk.org/en/statement-comparability"]}, {"title": "Establish your German language proof, or confirm you are exempt", "body": "TestDaF and the DSH are the tests named by the portal; TestDaF is offered in over 100 countries as a paper-based and digital test. title_en: TNAU undergraduate counselling, step by step
summary_en: How Tamil Nadu Agricultural University admits UG students for 2026-27: a mandatory online application covering constituent and affiliated colleges, a Rs. 3,000 counselling fee, single-window online counselling, allotment on merit and communal reservation, and a Rs. 20,000 admission fee paid before certificate verification.
steps_json: [{"title": "Submit the online application to TNAU -- it is mandatory", "body": "Submitting the online application to TNAU is mandatory for admission to constituent AND affiliated colleges, through both counselling and the management quota. You choose your degree programme and college preferences while filling the application.", "links": ["https://tnau.ucanapply.com", "https://ucanapplym.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/TNAU+UG+Brochure+2026-2027+-+%2813.05.2026%29.pdf"]}, {"title": "Wait for the rank list and the call to counselling", "body": "Selection for general reservation across all UG degree programmes is done only through online counselling on a single-window system, following Government Order G.O. (Ms). No. 191, Agriculture - Farmers Welfare (A.U.) Department, dated 14.07.2025. After the rank lists are published, eligible applicants are notified on their registered e-mail and mobile. TNAU decides the shortlisting ratio from the number of applicants. The brochure is explicit: being called for online counselling does NOT guarantee a seat.", "links": ["https://ucanapplym.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/TNAU+UG+Brochure+2026-2027+-+%2813.05.2026%29.pdf"]}, {"title": "Pay the counselling fee", "body": "Shortlisted candidates must pay a non-refundable counselling fee of Rs. 3,000, reduced to Rs. 1,500 for SC, SCA and ST categories, through their login on the admissions portal. Candidates who do not pay it are not considered for online counselling at all.", "links": ["https://tnau.ucanapply.com", "https://ucanapplym.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/TNAU+UG+Brochure+2026-2027+-+%2813.05.2026%29.pdf"]}, {"title": "Revise your choices during online counselling -- once", "body": "During online counselling you may change the degree and college preferences you set at application time. Only the finally submitted choices are processed, confirmed by SMS and e-mail. If you change nothing, your application-time preferences stand. No further opportunity to modify college or course options is given in subsequent counselling or upward movement sessions.", "links": ["https://ucanapplym.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/TNAU+UG+Brochure+2026-2027+-+%2813.05.2026%29.pdf"]}, {"title": "Seat allotment on merit and communal reservation", "body": "At the close of each phase, allotment is made on your final course and college choice, merit, and communal reservation, and notified by SMS and e-mail. Category-wise reservation is Open Competition 31.0%, Backward Class 26.5%, Backward Class Muslim 3.5%, Most Backward Class and Denotified Communities 20.0%, Scheduled Caste 15.0%, Scheduled Caste (Arunthathiyars) 3.0% and Scheduled Tribes 1.0%. Only Tamil Nadu native candidates are considered for communal reservation, and a community certificate from another state is not accepted; without a valid permanent community certificate at verification the application is treated as Open Competition.", "links": ["https://ucanapplym.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/TNAU+UG+Brochure+2026-2027+-+%2813.05.2026%29.pdf"]}, {"title": "Pay the admission fee, then attend certificate verification", "body": "Before appearing for certificate verification at TNAU Coimbatore you must pay Rs. 20,000 as admission fee online; the allotment letter can only be downloaded after successful payment, and the amount is adjusted into your first-semester fee. Paying it does not guarantee the seat -- confirmation happens only after your certificates are verified and submitted in time. If any credential (marks, community, date of birth, nativity) is found incorrect on the day, that round's allotment is cancelled; you may be called for re-counselling on revised credentials with no assurance of a seat.", "links": ["https://ucanapplym.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/TNAU+UG+Brochure+2026-2027+-+%2813.05.2026%29.pdf"]}, {"title": "Decide on upward movement (sliding) -- the choice is final", "body": "At certificate verification, candidates and parents are briefed on upward movement and must choose willing or not willing. Once made the choice cannot be changed and no later request is entertained. If a vacancy arises, willing candidates move to their best preferred upward choice of degree and college on merit and communal reservation. Candidates who paid the counselling fee but got no seat in the first round remain in contention during subsequent upward movement.", "links": ["https://ucanapplym.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/TNAU+UG+Brochure+2026-2027+-+%2813.05.2026%29.pdf"]}, {"title": "Know the refund rules before you withdraw", "body": "The Rs. 20,000 admission fee is refundable if you never register in the first semester. It is NOT refundable if you withdraw an already secured government-quota seat in order to take a management-quota seat in an affiliated college, or if you discontinue the course after registering for the first semester. Delay or absence in submitting certificates and paying the fee cancels the secured seat.", "links": ["https://ucanapplym.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/TNAU+UG+Brochure+2026-2027+-+%2813.05.2026%29.pdf"]}, {"title": "Special reservation quotas counsel separately", "body": "Offline counselling is held for differently abled candidates, eminent sportspersons and ex-servicemen, ahead of general counselling. Candidates of Tamil Nadu nativity who applied under a special reservation remain eligible for general counselling too.", "links": ["https://ucanapplym.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/TNAU+UG+Brochure+2026-2027+-+%2813.05.2026%29.pdf"]}]

title_en: Maharashtra agriculture UG admission (MCAER), step by step
summary_en: How Maharashtra admits agriculture UG students for 2026-27: a mandatory state CET, a centralised CAP process run by the State CET Cell under MCAER rules, four agricultural universities split by district, a 51% minority quota, and mop-up rounds where physical presence beats your filed preferences.

MCAER -- the Maharashtra Council of Agricultural Education and Research, established under section 12 of the Maharashtra Agricultural Universities (Krishi Vidyapeeths) Act, 1983 -- sets the rules, and the State CET Cell, Mumbai publishes the prospectus and runs the process. The whole procedure is conducted under the control of the Admission Regulatory Authority (ARA), and every unaided private college must obtain ARA approval for its admissions after the process closes.", "links": ["https://mcaer.org/", "https://mcaer.org/documents/MAURB/print%20UG%20Prospectus26-27%20english.pdf"]}, {"title": "Check which courses are covered", "body": "Nine professional degree courses are admitted through this process: B.Sc. (Hons) Community Science, B.Tech (Biotechnology) and B.Sc. (Hons) Agri-business Management. They are notified as professional educational courses under the Maharashtra Unaided Private Professional Educational Institutions (Regulation of Admissions and Fees) Act, 2015.", "links": ["https://mcaer.org/documents/MAURB/print%20UG%20Prospectus26-27%20english.pdf"]}, {"title": "Find which agricultural university your district falls under", "body": "The four agricultural universities divide Maharashtra by district. title_en: Madhya Pradesh agriculture UG counselling (RVSKVV & JNKVV)
summary_en: How Madhya Pradesh admits agriculture UG students for 2026: a joint RVSKVV and JNKVV counselling run entirely on MPESB PAT 2026 rank through the MPOnline portal, with non-refundable fees at every stage, Free seats only for MP domiciles, a Rs. 5,000 part payment before the allotment letter, and an upgradation option you must opt into or lose.
steps_json: [{"title": "Sit MPESB PAT 2026 -- it is the only basis for counselling", "body": "UG counselling for Rajmata Vijayaraje Scindia Krishi Vishwa Vidyalaya, Gwalior and Jawaharlal Nehru Krishi Vishwa Vidyalaya, Jabalpur is run jointly and entirely on the MPESB PAT 2026 examination. Only candidates who appeared for PAT 2026 may take part, and the rulebook of the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board, Bhopal for PAT 2026 is followed strictly. The whole process is online at the MPOnline portal.", "links": ["https://www.jnkvv.org/public/imageslider/1783685236.PAT%20Advisory%202026.pdf", "https://kvv.mponline.gov.in"]}, {"title": "Register and pay -- and note the fee is non-refundable", "body": "Create a profile on the portal and fill the registration form. Deadlines are not extended for network failures, computer malfunctions, technical errors, power cuts or lack of information, so do not leave it late.", "links": ["https://kvv.mponline.gov.in", "https://www.jnkvv.org/public/imageslider/1783685236.PAT%20Advisory%202026.pdf"]}, {"title": "Understand what you can no longer change", "body": "The personal details you gave in the MPESB PAT 2026 application -- your name, father's and mother's names, date of birth, gender, domicile status, category, class, and your Payment Seat option -- carry into counselling and cannot be altered. title_en: Punjab Agricultural University admission and counselling
summary_en: How PAU Ludhiana admits for 2026-27: a Punjab/Chandigarh domicile rule covering almost every programme, entrance tests with a handful of named exceptions, counselling you forfeit your seat by skipping, rank-wise allotment on priorities filled at counselling itself, and an All-India mop-up on +2 merit if seats remain.
steps_json: [{"title": "Check the domicile rule first -- it excludes most outsiders", "body": "Only residents of Punjab or the Union Territory of Chandigarh are eligible for admission to all undergraduate, Masters' and Diploma programmes. The exceptions are MBA and M.Tech (Remote Sensing & Geographic Information System), where 85% of seats go to state-domicile candidates and 15% to candidates of other states, and self-supporting programmes, which carry 15% additional seats for other states. Ph.D. admission is on an All-India basis.", "links": ["https://pau-apms.in/prospectus/Prospectus2026.pdf"]}, {"title": "Sit the PAU Entrance Test", "body": "Admission to all programmes is through the Entrance Tests, except for M.Tech (Remote Sensing & GIS), M.Tech Artificial Intelligence & Data Science in Agriculture, M.Tech Robotics and Automation, MCA, the Certificate Courses in Early Childhood Care & Education and in Interior Design & Decoration, and the PG Diploma in Robotics & Mechatronics in Agriculture. Eligibility and original certificates -- including the provisional degree certificate and notification of the qualifying examination -- are checked at counselling and document verification only. Fail to produce original mark sheets there and your candidature is not considered for seat allotment.", "links": ["https://pau-apms.in/prospectus/Prospectus2026.pdf"]}, {"title": "Attend counselling -- absence alone forfeits your seat", "body": "Every candidate must take part in the counselling, document verification and interview process as scheduled. Candidates who do not participate are simply not considered for seat allotment, however high their rank. If you miss the first counselling you may attend a subsequent one per the published schedule. Dates are not ordinarily changed even if the University is closed that day; any change is notified on pau.edu.", "links": ["https://www.pau.edu/", "https://pau-apms.in/prospectus/Prospectus2026.pdf"]}, {"title": "Allotment is rank-wise on the priorities you fill at counselling", "body": "Seats are allotted rank and merit wise, against the choice and priority of programme you fill in while participating in counselling or document verification -- not from anything submitted earlier.", "links": ["https://pau-apms.in/prospectus/Prospectus2026.pdf"]}, {"title": "Use the prescribed affidavit formats exactly", "body": "Newly admitted candidates submit original certificates and testimonials to the concerned Dean at counselling. All affidavits and testimonials must strictly follow the formats printed in the prospectus -- anything in another format will not be considered.", "links": ["https://pau-apms.in/prospectus/Prospectus2026.pdf"]}, {"title": "Know what silently cancels an admission", "body": "The Registrar may cancel an admission obtained by misrepresentation or concealment of facts. The Selection Committee weighs past conduct and may refuse a candidate involved in acts of indiscipline; anyone expelled, rusticated or debarred by PAU or another university is not admitted, and concealing such involvement cancels the admission later. title_en: Kerala agriculture admission through KEAM and NEET-UG
summary_en: How Kerala admits agriculture students for 2026: B.Sc.(Hons) Agriculture and its siblings are allotted on NEET-UG merit rather than any agriculture entrance test, while B.Tech Agricultural Engineering follows the engineering route -- through CEE's Centralized Allotment Process, with reservation claims that cannot be added or altered after you submit.
steps_json: [{"title": "Sit NEET-UG -- not an agriculture entrance test", "body": "This is the single most misunderstood thing about agriculture admission in Kerala. Admission to Agriculture, Forestry, B.Sc.(Hons) Co-operation & Banking / Agri Business Management, Climate Change & Environmental Science, B.Tech Biotechnology, Veterinary and Fisheries courses is regulated on merit as assessed in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET-UG 2026) conducted by the NTA. CEE then prepares a Kerala State Rank List from those NEET-UG scores.", "links": ["https://cee.kerala.gov.in/keam2026/pdf/Prospectus.pdf"]}, {"title": "Check which stream your course actually sits in", "body": "The agriculture family is split across two entirely different entrance routes. But B.Tech (Agricultural Engineering), B.Tech (Food Technology) and B.Tech (Dairy Technology) are listed as Engineering courses and follow the engineering route instead -- even though several are taught under Kerala Agricultural University.", "links": ["https://cee.kerala.gov.in/keam2026/pdf/Prospectus.pdf"]}, {"title": "Know which university you are actually applying to", "body": "Three universities share these courses. Kerala Agricultural University (KAU) offers B.Sc.(Hons) Agriculture, Forestry, Co-operation & Banking / Agri Business Management, Climate Change & Environmental Science, B.Tech Biotechnology, B.Tech Agricultural Engineering and B.Tech Food Technology. Kerala Veterinary & Animal Sciences University (KVASU) offers BVSc & AH, B.Tech Dairy Technology and B.Tech Food Technology. Kerala University of Fisheries & Ocean Studies (KUFOS) offers BFSc and B.Tech Food Technology.", "links": ["https://cee.kerala.gov.in/keam2026/pdf/Prospectus.pdf"]}, {"title": "Make every reservation claim in the original application -- it is irreversible", "body": "Claims for Special or Mandatory reservation must be made in the online application itself, in the appropriate places, with supporting documents uploaded within the stipulated time. Claims made after the application is submitted are not entertained even if you produce the evidence, and a claim once made cannot be altered under any circumstance. Only candidates in the 'Keralite' category may claim Special or Mandatory reservation.", "links": ["https://cee.kerala.gov.in/keam2026/pdf/Prospectus.pdf"]}, {"title": "Go through the Centralized Allotment Process", "body": "The Commissioner for Entrance Examinations, established in 1983 under G.O.(MS) No-31/83/HEDn, conducts both the examinations and the allotment to professional degree courses on the basis of merit and communal reservation. Allotment runs through the Centralized Allotment Process (CAP), a single-window system, in successive phases with option registration before each.", "links": ["https://cee.kerala.gov.in/", "https://cee.kerala.gov.in/keam2026"]}, {"title": "Understand how unfilled category seats move", "body": "Seats earmarked for special reservation categories in Agriculture, Veterinary and Fisheries are filled only with candidates from those categories. title_en: GBPUAT Pantnagar admission and entrance examination
